Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting purchases by school districts from sales and use taxes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to excise tax exemptions for school districts;adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; and adding a new section tochapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 shall not apply to sales to schooldistricts.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter shall not apply in respect to theuse of tangible personal property by school districts.
